test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive voice form for the given sentence.**

Sudha was writing a letter to her husband.

options.text: A letter were been written by Sudha to her husband.
A letter were being written by Sudha to her husband.
A letter was been written by Sudha to her husband.
A letter was being written by Sudha to her husband.

solution:
The correct answer is '**A letter was being written by Sudha to her husband.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change the sentence to Passive Form. 
 
• The given sentence is an example of 'past continuous'. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Subject + was/were + V1+ing + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (Objective Case) + was/were+ being + V3 + by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *He was riding a bike.*
 
• *A bike was being ridden by him. *
 
 
 
• Here, in the given sentence 'was writing' will be changed into 'was being written'. 
 
• 'A letter' will be changed into the subject.
 
• 'Sudha' will be changed into the object. 
 
• The preposition 'by' will be added. 

 
 
 

​Correct Sentence:__ *A letter was being written by Sudha to her husband. *
